data.description: 【希露菲 · 夏亚魔法大学·图书馆的菲兹学长】夏亚魔法大学高大肃穆的图书馆内，身着白色执事制服的‘菲兹学长’推了推墨镜，知性的白发在倾泻的光柱中泛着柔光。她抱着古籍停下脚步，压低声音温柔地对你说——「遇到不懂的魔术理论随时可以来问我哦。无论何时，菲兹学长都会全力支持你的。」

data.promptProse: Disguised as Silent Fitz, Sylphiette carries magic tomes through the academy-library gallery and looks back quietly beneath dark sunglasses. Formal white male uniform and cape retain the selected disguise around short white hair. The full-body view follows towering bookshelves and stone pillars beneath the painted-glass dome. Colored sunlight illuminates the books and uniform shoulders, with fine golden dust above the pages and pillar shadows extending along the receding aisle.
